title: Search Smart: Databases, Keywords and Reliable Sources
objective: Students practice finding biology information using search terms and source evaluation.
context: You want to find papers about frogs in city ponds. Source A lists an author, a method, a date and references. Source B is an unsigned post with no sources.

items.prompt: Write a search with two ideas joined by AND.
items.hint: One idea is the animal. One is the place.

items.prompt: Add a second word for “city” using OR.
items.answer: Example: frogs AND (city OR urban) AND ponds.
items.hint: Put two similar words in brackets.

items.prompt: Which source would you read first? Give two reasons.
items.answer: Source A. Accept two details such as named author, methods, date, or references.
items.hint: Check who wrote it and how the information was collected.
